questions.question: By next month, she ____ here for 5 years.
questions.explanation: 'For 5 years' + 'by next month' → nhấn mạnh thời gian kéo dài đến một mốc tương lai → dùng Future Perfect Continuous.

questions.question: By this time tomorrow, they ____ for 10 hours.
questions.explanation: 'For 10 hours' trước mốc tương lai → hành động kéo dài → dùng Future Perfect Continuous.

questions.question: He ____ for 3 hours by the time you arrive.
questions.explanation: 'By the time you arrive' → hành động đang diễn ra trước mốc tương lai và kéo dài → dùng Future Perfect Continuous.

questions.question: We ____ the whole morning by noon.
questions.explanation: 'The whole morning' → nhấn mạnh quá trình kéo dài trước 'by noon'.

questions.question: She ____ for years before she becomes famous.
questions.explanation: 'For years' + hành động trước khi nổi tiếng → dùng Future Perfect Continuous.

questions.question: They ____ English for 6 months by July.
questions.explanation: 'For 6 months' trước mốc 'by July' → dùng Future Perfect Continuous.

questions.question: He ____ here for more than 8 hours by the time the manager comes.
questions.explanation: Hành động chờ kéo dài trước mốc tương lai → dùng Future Perfect Continuous.

questions.question: We ____ for two hours by the time the movie ends.
questions.explanation: 'For two hours' + 'by the time' → hành động kéo dài trước mốc tương lai.

questions.question: By next summer, she ____ yoga for 10 years.
questions.explanation: 'For 10 years' → diễn tả quá trình kéo dài đến mốc tương lai → dùng Future Perfect Continuous.

questions.question: They ____ the project for months by the end of the year.
questions.explanation: 'For months' + 'by the end of the year' → dùng Future Perfect Continuous.

questions.question: He ____ piano for three years by next March.
questions.explanation: Hành động học kéo dài đến 'by next March' → dùng Future Perfect Continuous.

questions.question: By this time next week, we ____ the route for 5 days.
questions.explanation: 'For 5 days' → hành động kéo dài trong tương lai đến thời điểm cụ thể.

questions.question: She ____ science for 7 hours by the time he calls.
questions.explanation: 'For 7 hours' trước mốc 'by the time he calls' → dùng Future Perfect Continuous.

questions.question: They ____ for a long time by the time we reach them.
questions.explanation: 'For a long time' + mốc tương lai → dùng Future Perfect Continuous.

questions.question: He ____ coding for years before he becomes an expert.
questions.explanation: Hành động kéo dài nhiều năm trước khi trở thành chuyên gia → dùng Future Perfect Continuous.
